title: Test agent effort through its output contract

intentCoverage.report:
Dough Intent Coverage — SEED-345#test-agent-effort-through-its-output-contract at 5b681b21de957aa8bff10066fe4bad6558d8b16a

Verdict: Caught.

Promise (Key example 2): baseline input 100, candidate selections 30, 20 and repeated 30 → compare → candidate group input 50, like-host difference -50, executions inspectable, supplied proof/rescue notes visible, no winner.

Fault: dashboard/server/agentEffortComparison.ts, per-metric like-host delta changed from `value: right.value - left.value` to `value: left.value - right.value` (baseline minus candidate). The suggested fault was validated against the source and kept unchanged; the alternative (non-deduplicated sum) was not run, since its stored/native overlap counterpart was already observed during execution.

Maintained check: dashboard/backend-tests/usage-history/agent-effort-compare-groups.spec.ts, "explicit continuation groups deduplicate overlapping selections and retain per-execution peaks, settings and supplied judgment context". Command: `npm run test:dashboard:backend -- usage-history/agent-effort-compare-groups --workers=2 --reporter=list`, run under caffeinate -s -i and env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES.

Runs:
- Setup: detached scratch worktree at the selected revision, npm ci on Node 24.21.0. The tree was clean before the probe.
- Baseline: 2 passed (7.6s, including the cold start). Both tests ran.
- Faulted: the target test failed at line 91, `expect(actual.deltas[0]?.totals.totalInput?.value).toBe(-50)`, Expected -50, Received 50. Reach and wrong behavior: the comparison output's like-host totalInput delta was +50 on the example-2 fixture. The test reached line 91 only after its earlier assertions passed on that run (candidate executions [30,20,30], candidate group input 50, peaks [20,30]), so deduplication was intact and only the direction was wrong. The sibling mixed-host test passed. It has no token delta to catch.
- Assertion detail: the earlier `expect(readable).toEqual(stated)` (line 79) passed under the fault because the readable view faithfully reflects the JSON's wrong +50. The readable-equality reader proves only that the two views agree. The explicit -50 assertion is the one that catches the direction.
- Restoration: a trap ran git checkout of the file. git diff was clean afterwards. The same command passed again (2 passed, 2.0s). The scratch worktree was removed with git worktree remove --force.

Next proof action: none needed for this fault on this path. The maintained -50 assertion catches a reversed like-host delta.

Prior disposition: this matches no planned repair.

Costs:
- Test runtime (measured, Playwright-reported wall time per run): baseline 7.6s, faulted 1.8s, restored 2.0s. Total about 11.4s.
- Human effort: unavailable. No separately supported human measure. No human interaction happened during the probe.
- Agent effort: unavailable. No separately supported token or turn measure is exposed to this agent.
- Invocation-to-report elapsed: 55876 ms (measured), from 1794926669016 to 1794926724892 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

## Wrap-up disposition

5b681b21de957aa8bff10066fe4bad6558d8b16a — Caught; no follow-up.
